dataset.name: Paddy Doctor (10-class labelled release)
dataset.authors: Petchiammal A., Briskline Kiruba S., Murugan D., Pandarasamy Arjunan
dataset.origin: Paddy fields near Tirunelveli, Tamil Nadu

provenance.disclosure: States A-D are label-skewed partitions of one public Tamil Nadu dataset (Paddy Doctor). They do not describe real pest prevalence in any state.

hard_subset.rule: held-out images whose nearest training image (any state) has cosine < 0.95
